Machines Real computers, leased by the org, for agents and for the software they ship.

a: Record Every act on every layer, by a person or an agent, in one trail.

p: Lease a sandbox and run commands in it, launch a metered machine, or publish a function. Each is the org’s own and each is billed to it, so an agent that needs a computer asks for one the same way a person would.
Operations on api.hanzo.ai. One key reaches every layer.

table: Leases a sandbox — a real computer — for the org.
Runs one command in a sandbox and answers with its exit code, stdout and stderr.
Lists the machine sizes available to launch.
Launches a metered machine, or prices one first with dryRun.
Publishes a serverless function under the org.
Runs a function and records the invocation.
